goal: Belge match ve approval sonucunu request body yerine workspace kapsamlı kalıcı karar kaydına almak
rollback: Bu paketin karar modeli/migration ve testini geri al; mevcut belge, ödeme, teslimat ve veritabanı verilerine dokunma
acceptance: Decision record is tenant and document scoped
Approval actor and match candidate are persisted without raw PII or provider secrets
Ready transition can require the durable decision record
Unique document decision prevents approval replay side effects
